definitions.explanation: A traditional form of Japanese comedy featuring two performers: a straight man (tsukkomi) and a funny man (boke) in rapid-fire dialogue.

examples.japanese: {漫才|まんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
{漫才|まんざい}⟦コンビ→コンビ：27903_konbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んで→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm part of a manzai duo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{漫才|まんざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
⟦ボケ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{突|つ}っ{込|こ}み→ツッコミ：09412_tsukkomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{掛|か}け{合|あ}い→掛け合い：28500_kakeai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{漫才|まんざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}さ→面白さ：28501_omoshirosa⟧だ。
examples.english: The back-and-forth between the funny man and straight man is what makes manzai entertaining.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{漫才|まんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦みたら→みる：00283_miru⟧、⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{難|むずか}しかった→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: When I tried doing manzai with a friend, it was harder than I expected.

notes:
COMPOUND: {漫|まん} (random, comic) + {才|さい} (talent)

KEY ROLES:
- ⟦ボケ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧ (funny man) - delivers absurd/silly lines
- ⟦{突|つ}っ{込|こ}み→ツッコミ：09412_tsukkomi⟧ (straight man) - corrects and reacts to boke

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漫才|まんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧/⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (to do manzai)
- {漫才|まんざい}⟦コンビ→コンビ：27903_konbi⟧ (manzai duo)
- ⟦{漫才|まんざい}{師|し}→漫才師：22032_manzaishi⟧ (manzai performer)
- M-1⟦グランプリ→グランプリ：10827_guranpuri⟧ (M-1 Grand Prix - famous manzai competition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {漫才|まんざい} - duo comedy, dialogue-based
- ⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧ - solo comedic storytelling
- ⟦コント→コント：28499_konto⟧ - sketch comedy
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦ボケ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧⟦{突|つ}っ{込|こ}み→ツッコミ：09412_tsukkomi⟧ (solo routine playing both roles)

OSAKA CONNECTION:
Manzai is strongly associated with Osaka and the Kansai region. Major talent agencies like {吉本興業|よしもとこうぎょう} are based there.
